newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down six cents on larger offering.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down six cents on larger offering.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price extended its downtrend, falling six cents to 14.26 ringgit ($5.74) a kg at the close, traders said.
A small rebound on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight did not help sentiment which remained affected by a high local premium over the London price, they said.
"There was a high offering (of 192 tonnes) and buyers only appeared at the lower levels," said a trader.
Final turnover was 137 tonnes, up from 91 on Thursday.
The local premium over LME was $70 a tonne against $115 previously.--Syed Azman (603-230 8911) ($1=2.4860 ringgit)
